detail.ja: サイズ最適化版を書き込み、起動・mem・ps・lsを確認。全機能回帰は未実施。
detail.en: Size-optimized firmware flashed; boot, mem, ps and ls verified. Full regression pending.

title.ja: OS基盤：浮動小数点コンテキスト

detail.ja: ESP32-P4の協調切替でFP保存レジスタとFCSR、タイマー割り込みで全FPレジスタとFCSRを保存・復元。実機タスク間分離試験とホストの配置・初期化試験に成功。全命令・全ISRの網羅検証ではない。
detail.en: ESP32-P4 cooperative switches preserve FP callee registers and FCSR; timer interrupts preserve all FP registers and FCSR. Hardware task-isolation and host layout/initialization tests passed. This is not exhaustive instruction or ISR validation.

detail.ja: 独自DMA版で37・512・8192バイトの読み書き・再起動後保持を確認。再接続処理も修正し、I/O停止中の抜き差し1回で再マウント、既存全内容一致、新規512バイトの読み書きを確認。TinyUSBは比較用。受信機の直接接続と高速ハブ経由の入力も確認済み。Buffer DMA切替後のストレージ読み書き回帰試験は残件。
detail.en: Native DMA verified: 37, 512 and 8192 byte write/read and persistence. Reconnection corrected; one idle unplug/replug cycle passed remount, full original-file readback and a new 512-byte write/read. TinyUSB retained for comparison. Receiver input passed both directly and through a High-Speed hub. Storage write/read regression after the Buffer DMA conversion remains pending.

detail.ja: SPI接続、/sd FATマウント、一覧取得、新規38バイト書き込み・読み戻し・再起動後保持、/usbとの同時マウントを実機確認。高速化・抜き差しは未検証。
detail.en: Verified on hardware: SPI access, /sd FAT mount, listing, 38-byte test file write/read and persistence after reset, simultaneous /usb mount. Speed optimization and hot-plug unverified.

title.ja: 3. USBハブ・複数メモリ・キーボード併用
title.en: 3. USB hubs, multiple drives and keyboard coexistence

detail.ja: 独自Buffer DMAへ統一し、高速ハブ配下のFull-Speed無線受信機をスプリット転送で認識。入力レポート・シェル実行をログとユーザー操作で確認。USBメモリ2本のマウント、Ethernet ping 10/10も確認。診断表示は削除。新方式での読み書き併用試験は、接続機器がなくなったため未確認。従来方式では2本のCRC付き読み書きを確認済み。
detail.en: Unified the native host on Buffer DMA and added split transfers for a Full-Speed wireless receiver beneath a High-Speed hub. Reports and shell commands were verified in logs and by the user; two drives mounted and Ethernet ping passed 10/10. Diagnostics removed. New-engine write/read coexistence remains unverified because USB devices were absent during the attempt. Earlier CRC write/read results apply to the previous engine.

detail.ja: RTL8153 CDC-ECMでリンク・DHCP・ping・SSHを実機確認。MSCのDMA待機中にUSBロックを解放し、USBメモリ2本の読み書きとping併用で各20/20応答、USBエラー・ドロップ0。長時間試験と抜き差し時の通信継続は未確認。
detail.en: RTL8153 CDC-ECM passed hardware link, DHCP, ping and SSH. Releasing the USB lock during MSC DMA waits enabled reads/writes on both drives alongside 20/20 ping replies per test with zero USB errors or drops. Long-duration and hot-plug continuity tests remain pending.

detail.ja: C6を公式MCUアプリへSDIO更新。再起動後の維持、Wi-Fi初期化・検索・WPA2接続・DHCPを確認。LANケーブルを抜きEthernet非アクティブの状態で、Wi-FiによるDNS名前解決とHTTP 200受信を実機確認。長時間通信と再接続試験は未実施。
detail.en: Updated C6 over SDIO to the official MCU application. Reset persistence, Wi-Fi initialization, scanning, WPA2 association and DHCP passed. With Ethernet unplugged and inactive, Wi-Fi DNS resolution and HTTP 200 retrieval passed on hardware. Long-duration traffic and reconnect tests remain pending.

title.ja: 4. SSHサーバー・クライアント同時動作

detail.ja: 共有コンソールへ接続するSSHサーバーを実装。実機で認証・コマンド実行・再接続・停止と、接続維持中のSSHクライアント実行を確認。Web/TailscaleとはTCP枠を分離。SFTP拡張を実装しホスト試験・全体ビルドに成功。独立PTY・execは未実装。SFTPの検証範囲は項目4bを参照。
detail.en: Shared-console SSH server implemented. Hardware authentication, commands, reconnect, stop and outbound SSH while keeping inbound SSH active passed. TCP slots are separate from Web/Tailscale. The SFTP extension passed host tests and the complete target build. Independent PTYs and exec are not implemented; see item 4b for SFTP validation scope.

detail.ja: LCD/SSHに256色・RGB、スクロール領域、行挿入削除、カーソル保存復元、代替画面等を実装。SSHは問い合わせ応答とDECCKM、Vimキー透過も追加。実parserのホスト検証済み。SLは実機シリアルのANSI出力・正常完走・中断復帰を確認。Vim通し確認、SL表示の目視評価と完全なVT220/xterm互換は未達。
detail.en: LCD/SSH implement 256/RGB colors, scroll margins, line edits, cursor save/restore and alternate screens. SSH adds DSR, DECCKM and Vim key passthrough. Actual-parser host tests passed; SL passed hardware serial ANSI completion and interrupted return. Device Vim checks, visual SL assessment and full VT220/xterm compatibility remain pending.

title.ja: 4b. SFTP・Linuxストレージヘルパー

detail.ja: SFTP v3エンジン、SD／USBの公開範囲制限、読み取り専用の既定方針、FATの排他的新規作成を実装。Python標準ライブラリ＋OpenSSHの単体ヘルパーはconnectで既存SSHFS／FUSEを試し、利用不可なら対話的ファイル転送へ切替。ホスト試験・全体ビルドは成功。実機のローカルSFTPエンジン試験でSDへ新規8192バイトを書き込み、読み戻し、既存EXCL拒否、その後の内容保持を確認。Wi-Fi実機へParamikoとヘルパーの実SFTPクライアントクラスでSDの102400バイト往復転送2回、既存EXCL拒否・内容保持・削除・再接続、RO一覧と書込み拒否が成功。認証前にシリアルのSHA256ホスト鍵指紋を照合。実ヘルパープロセス＋Windows OpenSSH 9でSD20480バイトput/get一致・ls/rmにも成功。ユーザーSSH設定は変更せず指紋照合済みの隔離known_hostsを使用。Linux実プロセス・FUSEとUSBのネットワーク転送は未確認。現在1受信接続のみで、Tab5発SSHを使う逆方向公開は未実装。
detail.en: Implemented the SFTP v3 engine, SD/USB export boundaries, read-only default policy and atomic FAT exclusive creation. A standalone Python standard-library/OpenSSH helper uses connect to try existing SSHFS/FUSE, falling back to interactive file transfer. Host tests and the complete target build passed. The local SFTP engine passed an SD hardware self-test: fresh 8192-byte write/read, refusal of existing-file EXCL and unchanged contents on reread. Over hardware Wi-Fi, Paramiko and the actual helper SFTP client class passed two 102400-byte SD roundtrips, existing-file EXCL/content preservation, delete/reconnect, and read-only listing/write rejection. The serial SHA256 host-key fingerprint was checked before authentication. The actual helper process with Windows OpenSSH 9 also passed an exact 20480-byte SD put/get and ls/rm using fingerprint-verified isolated known_hosts without changing user SSH settings. Actual Linux process/FUSE tests and USB network transfers remain unverified. Only one inbound connection is supported; reverse export through Tab5-initiated SSH is not implemented.

title.ja: 5. タッチ入力・コンソールスクロール

detail.ja: 256行の色付き履歴、上下スワイプ、最新出力への復帰を実装。ST7121端末でユーザーがスクロールを確認。2面描画は実機で更新20回・DMA完了20回、エラー・タイムアウト0。ちらつき改善の目視評価と長時間試験は未実施。 UVC同時実行でも描画16/16完了・エラー0だが、最大更新時間1.642秒となり高負荷時の応答遅延は残る。
detail.en: 256-line colored history, vertical swipes and return to live output implemented. The user confirmed scrolling on ST7121. Two-buffer rendering passed 20 updates and 20 DMA-confirmed retirements with zero errors/timeouts. Subjective flicker reduction and long-duration tests remain unverified. With UVC active, display retirement passed 16/16 with zero errors, but maximum batch time reached 1.642 seconds; high-load response latency remains.

detail.ja: C6のSDIO HCI経由でBLE初期化に成功（ready、error 0）。3秒の受動探索で周辺2台を検出。HCI TX20／RX22、failed 0／reject 0。自動接続は行わず、ペアリング済みHID機器によるキーボード／マウス入力・再接続は未確認。Classicは別途調査。 BLE起動・探索後もWi-FiでHTTP 200・577バイトの受信を確認。現状の接続管理は1相手機器に限定。
detail.en: BLE initialization passed through C6 SDIO HCI (ready, error 0). A 3-second passive scan discovered two nearby devices; HCI TX20/RX22, failed 0/reject 0. No automatic connection was attempted. Paired HID keyboard/mouse input and reconnect remain unverified; Classic requires separate assessment. Wi-Fi HTTP 200 retrieval (577 bytes) also passed after BLE startup and scanning. Current connection management is limited to one peer.

detail.ja: 接続UVCカメラで160×120の単一フレーム取得とBMP保存に実機成功。2688バイトのペイロードとalt6を使用し、High-Speedの3トランザクション転送に対応。画像品質、連続取得、プレビュー、抜き差しは未確認。 現状は1フレーム取得に約8〜10秒を要し、不正・不完全なパケットが多く、実用的なフレームレートには達していない。 BMP読戻しで19113/19200画素が非ゼロ、値の変化を確認（FNV 9c385858）。色・向き・画質の目視確認は未実施。
detail.en: The connected UVC camera passed hardware capture of one 160×120 frame and BMP save, using a 2688-byte payload and alternate setting 6 with three High-Speed transactions. Image quality, sustained capture, preview and hot-plug remain unverified. Current acquisition takes about 8–10 seconds per complete frame, with many bad/incomplete payload observations; a practical frame rate has not been achieved. BMP readback found 19113/19200 nonzero pixels with varying values (FNV 9c385858); visual color/orientation/quality checks remain pending.

detail.ja: SC202CS（ID eb52）のCSI／ISP経由RGB565取得を実機確認。640×360画像をmicroSDへ460870バイトのBMPとして保存。停止・再起動・再取得も成功、DMAエラー0。画像品質、連続フレームレート、長時間動作は未評価。 BMP読戻しで230400画素すべて非ゼロ、値の変化を確認（FNV 07d53fa4）。
detail.en: Native CSI/ISP RGB565 capture passed on SC202CS (ID eb52). A 640×360 image was saved to microSD as a 460870-byte BMP. Stop/restart and a fresh frame passed with zero DMA errors. Image quality, sustained frame rate and long-duration operation remain unmeasured. BMP readback found all 230400 pixels nonzero with varying values (FNV 07d53fa4).

title.en: 9. External GPIO, ADC, PWM, I2C, SPI and UART

detail.ja: 共通C APIとGPIO／未校正ADC／PWM／SoftI2C／SoftSPI／UART1のシェル操作を実装。ホスト試験・全体ビルドに成功。実機で予約ピン拒否、GPIO16入力・解放・reset、ADC16／53生値取得、UART内部ループバックに成功。ADC35は非対応として拒否。外部機器・基準電圧・PWM波形・I2C／SPI／UART配線試験は未確認。Python側は項目10／10aを参照。汎用DACは対象外。
detail.en: Shared C services and shell control for GPIO, uncalibrated ADC, PWM, SoftI2C/SoftSPI and UART1 are implemented; host tests and the complete target build passed. Hardware checks passed reserved-pin rejection, GPIO16 input/release/reset, raw ADC16/53 sampling and internal UART loopback; ADC35 was rejected as unsupported. External devices, reference voltage, PWM waveforms and wired I2C/SPI/UART remain unverified. See items 10/10a for Python bindings. General-purpose DAC is excluded.

detail.ja: MicroPython v1.26.1をMeOSへ直接組み込む初期ポート、REPL・スクリプト・VFS連携、machine.Pin／ADCを実装。GCヒープはPSRAM 512 KiB、タスクスタックは32 KiB。共通IO所有権を使用し、VM終了時にファイルとピンを回収する。全体ビルド・書込みに成功。実機REPLで2**80・math.sqrt(9)・GCを確認し、GPIO16入力・ADC16/53・予約/重複/解放済みオブジェクト拒否・40回GC負荷のsmoke.pyが成功。実機SDスクリプトで隣接モジュールimport、排他的1024バイト新規ファイルの読み書き・seek/tell・closeに成功。意図的例外後のPin再確保、MemoryError後のVM再起動、無限ループCtrl-C後のシェル復帰と次VM実行も確認。初期機能の限定検証であり、長時間動作は未評価。外部出力波形は未確認。PWM／UART／SoftI2C／SoftSPI／timeの拡張は項目10aを参照。IRQとCPython・Pyxel互換は含まない。
detail.en: Implemented the initial native MeOS port of MicroPython v1.26.1, REPL/scripts/VFS integration and machine.Pin / ADC. The GC heap uses 512 KiB PSRAM with a 32 KiB task stack. Shared IO ownership and VM-exit file/pin cleanup are provided. The complete target build and flashing passed. Hardware REPL checks passed 2**80, math.sqrt(9) and GC; smoke.py passed GPIO16 input, ADC16/53, reserved/duplicate/released-object rejection and 40 GC pressure cycles. An SD script passed sibling-module import and exclusive 1024-byte file write/read, seek/tell and close. Pin reclaim after an intentional exception, VM restart after MemoryError and Ctrl-C interruption of an infinite loop followed by shell return/new VM execution also passed. These verify the initial feature scope; long-duration operation is unmeasured. External output waveforms remain unverified. See item 10a for PWM/UART/SoftI2C/SoftSPI/time additions. IRQ and CPython/Pyxel compatibility are not included.

title.en: 10a. Python peripheral IO and monotonic time

detail.ja: PWM、UART1、SoftI2C、SoftSPIとtimeを実装。実32ビットMicroPython VM＋IOモックで機能・例外後解放を検証（156サービス呼出し、UART受理8バイト）。実機では外部出力を行わないPWM拒否、UART設定拒否、バス23安全拒否試験とtimeの範囲・wrap・delayが成功。time.sleep(60)のCtrl-C復帰は約0.125秒。ファーム増加6464バイト。実PWM波形・UART配線通信・I2C/SPI機器通信は未確認。IRQは未実装。
detail.en: Implemented PWM, UART1, SoftI2C, SoftSPI and time. The actual 32-bit MicroPython VM with mocked IO passed functional and exception-cleanup tests (156 service calls, eight accepted UART bytes). Hardware passed no-output PWM rejection, UART configuration rejection,23 bus safety checks and time range/wrap/delay tests. Ctrl-C returned from time.sleep(60) in about 0.125 seconds. Firmware grew by 6464 bytes. Physical PWM waveforms, wired UART and real I2C/SPI device communication remain unverified; IRQ is not implemented.

detail.ja: 上流SL 5.03のコード・素材・ライセンスを保持し、MeOS用最小ANSI/curses互換層とPSRAM描画・煙状態へ移植。ホスト90回超反復と全体ビルド・書込みに成功。実機シリアルで標準slが15.30秒・95329バイト出力で完走し、代替画面の開始/終了とシェル復帰を確認。sl -aFのCtrl-C、sl -lcのEscはいずれも約0.86秒で復帰し再実行成功。目視画質・LCD見え方・SSH経由描画は未評価。
detail.en: Ported upstream SL 5.03 with original code/assets/license retained, a minimal MeOS ANSI/curses-shaped adapter and PSRAM canvas/smoke state. More than 90 host runs and full target build/flash passed. On hardware serial, default sl completed in 15.30 seconds with 95329 output bytes, alternate-screen enter/exit and shell return. Ctrl-C during sl -aF and Esc during sl -lc each returned in about 0.86 seconds and reruns passed. Visual quality, LCD appearance and SSH rendering remain unassessed.

title.ja: FPGA通信：ソフトウェア基盤

detail.ja: 583件の互換ベクトル、分割・異常系とTab5上mock自己試験に合格。物理通信・GPIO・DDR3・DMAは未実装。
detail.en: 583 compatibility vectors, fragmented/fault tests and Tab5 mock selftest passed. Physical link, GPIO, DDR3 and DMA are not implemented.

detail.ja: image / image --infoを追加。実機で2x2 BMPの検査・表示開始・終了・RAM解放、描画エラーなしを確認。目視・大画像は未確認。JPEG/PNG未対応。
detail.en: Added image / image --info. A 2x2 BMP passed device inspection, viewer start/close, memory release and display error checks. Visual/large-image checks pending; JPEG/PNG unsupported.
